title: Quality Builder: Web & Cross-Platform
jobDescription:
Job description: Guard quality like the users are watching — because they are. You’ll own the line between “it works” and “it ships.” You’ll be closest to the edge cases, sharpest on what could break and fastest to catch it before a user […] Job description: Guard quality like the users are watching — because they are. You’ll own the line between “it works” and “it ships.” You’ll be closest to the edge cases, sharpest on what could break and fastest to catch it before a user does. Key focus areas Manual & exploratory testing · Test automation · CI/CD integration · Defect tracking What you'll do Translate requirements into test cases with the product and dev teams. Run functional, regression, and UAT on web and mobile apps. Hunt down, document, and track defects in JIRA. Design and maintain automated tests in Playwright (Java Script/Type Script) and Selenium (Java). Build and optimize scripts for new features and integrations. Wire automation into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, Git Lab CI) for faster feedback. Keep test coverage high and the suite maintainable. Spot ways to sharpen the framework and the process. Must haves 3-5 years in software testing, both manual and automation. Strong manual testing of web and mobile — test plans, test cases, exploratory. Automation in Playwright with Java Script/Type Script and Selenium with Java (Web Driver, Test NG or JUnit). Bug-tracking with JIRA or Azure Dev Ops. Git and version control. CI/CD familiarity. Solid grasp of automation best practices, test data management, and suite maintenance. SQL for database testing. Bachelor’s in CS, IT, or related. Good to haves Cloud testing platforms (Sauce Labs, Browser Stack). API testing with Postman. Agile practices (Scrum/Kanban). Performance and load testing. What we offer Full time · Bangalore · [email protected] Health cover up to ₹4L for your whole family, including parents. Flexible hours and location. Auto-approved vacations on team consensus. Self-managed career growth, yearly performance-based pay revision. Flat, bias-free, playful culture. Project and company bonuses. Real ownership of org-level work. title: Product Owner: Vision & Delivery
jobDescription:
Job description: Turn vision into reality, why into what, and help businesses create the future they want. You’ll be a product thinker and participative leader — sensing needs, articulating the why, and moving ideas to working software. You’ll be closest to the customer, […] Job description: Turn vision into reality, why into what, and help businesses create the future they want. You’ll be a product thinker and participative leader — sensing needs, articulating the why, and moving ideas to working software. You’ll be closest to the customer, clearest on the vision and fastest to turn ambiguity into a plan the team can run. Key focus areas Need sensing & requirements · Design-thinking facilitation · Agile delivery · Stakeholder trust What you'll do Work with business, product, design, and tech leaders to sense needs, mirror ideas, and articulate the why, what, how, and when. Be the single point of contact between customer (demand) and team (supply) for everything from requirement elaboration to delivery. Run design-thinking workshops with senior executives. Drive scrum ceremonies — sprints, retros, backlogs. Estimate effort, shape delivery roadmaps, and define milestones. Orchestrate cross-functional teams, mentor other POs, and build client relationships that deepen over time. Capture innovations and lessons back into the Codewave community. Must haves 4 – 5 years of experience in product ownership. Ability to work closely with business, product, design, and tech leaders to understand and articulate requirements. Strong facilitation and communication, including with senior leaders and clients. Proven Agile/Scrum delivery — sprints, retros, backlog management. Stakeholder management as the single point of contact, mitigating risk and holding team dynamics. Project planning across estimation, roadmaps, milestones, and release plans. A participative leadership style — you inspire teams, you don’t command them. Good to haves Familiarity with current tech, including cloud and edge, and able to articulate the technical shape of solutions. Budget management and reporting to clients. Planning non-dev activities like usability testing and deployment. Thrives in a flat, ego-free, talent-over-titles culture. title: Infra Builder: Senior DevOps & Cloud
jobDescription:
Job description: Build infrastructure teams trust and customers never notice. You’ll be closest to production, sharpest on what scales and fastest to turn incidents into automation. Key focus areas AWS cloud infrastructure · Kubernetes & containers · Terraform Ia C · CI/CD […] Job description: Build infrastructure teams trust and customers never notice. You’ll be closest to production, sharpest on what scales and fastest to turn incidents into automation. Key focus areas AWS cloud infrastructure · Kubernetes & containers · Terraform Ia C · CI/CD & observability What you'll do Design and run scalable, secure, highly available cloud infrastructure on AWS. Administer Kubernetes and Docker container platforms. Build and optimize CI/CD pipelines. Write Infrastructure as Code in Terraform — reusable modules, clean state management. Stand up monitoring, logging, and observability so problems surface before customers do. Bake security in with Dev Sec Ops: secrets management, vulnerability scanning, security automation. Design for high availability, disaster recovery, and performance. Troubleshoot complex production issues, lead infrastructure modernization, and mentor junior engineers into Dev Ops best practices. Must haves 5 to 6 years in Dev Ops. Strong expertise designing and managing scalable, secure, highly available AWS infrastructure. Advanced hands-on Kubernetes, Docker, and container platform administration. Extensive CI/CD pipeline experience with Git Hub Actions, Git Lab CI, Jenkins, or similar. Deep Terraform expertise including reusable modules and state management. Strong experience with Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/Open Search, and Cloud Watch. Dev Sec Ops practices — secrets management, vulnerability scanning, security automation. Strong scripting in Bash, Python, or Go. High availability, disaster recovery, backup strategies, and performance optimization. Ability to troubleshoot complex production issues and lead modernization initiatives. Experience mentoring engineers and driving Dev Ops practices across teams. Good to haves A platform-thinking instinct — building golden paths other engineers self-serve on, not one-off fixes.
